Step 3 (Determine What and How Much): It helps produce saliva and other fluids, regulates body temperature, carries nutrientsthrough the body, and is important for digestion (p. 52).

Step 4 (On level ground, continuously): Step 2, If the horse won't move, push the horse at thechest, where the muscles join (p. 49).
